name: zip
description: Bundles and compresses files into a .zip archive, the format most compatible with Windows and macOS. Mind the order: the archive name first, then the files to put in it. To include the contents of a directory, you need -r. If the archive already exists, the files are added or updated.

options.description: Includes directories and everything in them.
Protects the archive with a password (typed at the keyboard).
Replaces only the files changed since last time.
Removes the given files from the archive.
Stores the files without their directories.
Excludes the files matching the patterns that follow.

arguments.name: ARCHIVE.zip
arguments.description: Name of the archive to create or change.

examples.explanation: Creates an archive containing two files.
Archives a site without the logs or dependencies.
